answer: Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 110 epochs of grading, and every orchard settlement recomputes the meadow schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 110 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
